source_supported: 78 frame rivets in eight size groups; 32 are button-head 11/16 x 1.5 inch.

explicit_hypotheses: 80 mm formed returns on previously flat gussets, with sharp unmodeled bend radii.
Diaphragm forward shift and 32 mm overlap on each upright.
24 rivets on gusset/channel joints and eight on diaphragm/upright joints, with estimated hole patterns.
8 mm retained stock, 1.75 diameter head ratio, spherical-cap factory/upset heads, 0.15 mm radial fit allowance.
visual_limits: SNL23 and HB126 support the channel/casting arrangement but do not expose these rear hidden joints. This is a mechanically checked approximation, not proof of factory construction.
